name: The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
insider_take: A serene desert oasis tucked along the shores of Lake Las Vegas — a world away from the Strip's neon buzz, yet just 17 miles from all the action.
whats_special: Nestled on the banks of the 500-acre man-made Lake Las Vegas , offering stunning water and mountain views rarely associated with Vegas. Features a Heavenly Spa by Westin and the iconic Westin Heavenly Bed® — designed for deep recovery after desert adventures. Guests enjoy two resort pools , a private beach area, kayaking, and paddleboarding — an unexpected lakeside retreat in the Mojave Desert. Part of the Marriott Luminous program , meaning elite Marriott Bonvoy members enjoy elevated perks and recognition.
pro_tip: Book a lake-facing room for sunrise — the reflection of the McCullough Mountain Range across the still water is absolutely breathtaking and uniquely un-Vegas.
dont_miss: A stroll or bike ride along the Lake Las Vegas waterfront promenade , lined with Mediterranean-inspired architecture and boutique dining. The nearby Reflection Bay Golf Club , a Jack Nicklaus Signature Course ranked among Nevada's finest. The resort's signature Southwestern cuisine — fresh, locally inspired flavors that celebrate the spirit of the Mojave.
pros: Stunning lakefront location with serene mountain views
Peaceful retreat away from Las Vegas Strip crowds
Multiple dining options and outdoor recreational activities
cons: Remote location requires transportation to Las Vegas Strip
